description.zh: 筛选时间类型 支持按最近7天、最近30天、最近半年、自定义等方式进行时间的筛选。
description.en: The time filter type. Supports filtering by last 7 days, last 30 days, last half year, or custom time range.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mssp get-safety-cover --date-type month --start-date 1732255620000 --end-date 1732268720000 --susp-event-source '该接口不用传' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mssp GetSafetyCover --region cn-hangzhou --StartDate 1732255620000 --SuspEventSource '该接口不用传' --DateType month --EndDate 1732268720000
